column.name: title
column.value: Higher Education Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan

column.name: content
column.value: Article 16. Transfer of students between higher education institutions. Students have the right to transfer from one higher education institution to another. Transfer is permitted after completing the first academic year. The student must have a GPA of at least 3.0 on a 5.0 scale. Transfer applications must be submitted during the summer period (June 1 - August 15). Required documents: application letter, transcript, certificate of enrollment, and recommendation letter from the current institution.

column.name: content
column.value: Article 22. Academic leave. A student may take academic leave for valid reasons including: medical conditions (confirmed by medical commission), family circumstances, military service obligation, or participation in international academic programs. Academic leave duration is 1 year, extendable to 2 years for medical reasons. The student retains their enrollment status during academic leave. Reinstatement must be requested within 30 days after the leave period ends.

column.name: content
column.value: Article 28. Scholarships and financial support. State-funded (grant) students receive a monthly stipend. The base stipend amount is 930,000 UZS per month. Students with a GPA of 4.5 or higher receive an increased stipend of 1,395,000 UZS (150% of base). Presidential scholarship recipients receive 2,790,000 UZS (300% of base). Scholarship payments are made on the 15th of each month. Students on academic leave do not receive stipend payments.

column.name: content
column.value: Article 35. Complaints and appeals procedure. Students and their legal representatives have the right to file complaints regarding academic decisions, grading disputes, and administrative actions. Complaints must be submitted in writing to the institution first. If the institutional response is unsatisfactory, an appeal can be made to the Ministry of Higher Education within 30 days. The Ministry must respond within 15 working days. Appeals regarding exam results must be filed within 3 working days of grade publication.
